# Welcome to another world

Admire the finest Van Goghs and masterpieces by Claude Monet, Pablo Picasso, Charley Toorop and Piet Mondriaan. Stroll through the sculpture garden and discover 200 sculptures in the heart of De Hoge Veluwe National Park.

## The finest Van Gogh collection

The Kröller-Müller Museum has the finest Van Gogh collection in the world. Immerse yourself in the world of this Dutch master.

[Discover the Van Gogh collection](/en/about-the-collection/van-gogh-collection)

## Stroll through the sculpture garden

Explore one of the largest sculpture gardens in Europe and stroll among sculptures by artists such as Barbara Hepworth, Jean Dubuffet, and Marta Pan.

[More about the sculpture garden](/en/about-the-collection/sculpture-garden)

![Drone photo of the artwork *Jardin d’émail*, showing a black-and-white surface on a green grass field, surrounded by trees.](https://museumplatform.b-cdn.net/images/ex28vlu5/production/2fabbfc1e77bdab99d1ecfb13144658b2a79ea7d-1512x1720.png?w=3840&auto=format)

![Bronze abstract sculpture of a human figure in a dynamic, forward-leaning pose. The sculpture is composed of angular, fragmented forms and stands on a rectangular base against a neutral background.](https://museumplatform.b-cdn.net/images/ex28vlu5/production/18d2c89f26d7327afba64f1c9b0aed3dac43535c-1613x2500.jpg?w=3840&auto=format "Umberto Boccioni, _Forme uniche della continuità nello spazio_, 1913")

## Discover the collection

Take a stroll past the highlights of the Helene Kröller-Müller collection, from old masters to modern art.

[Search the collection](/en/collection) [About the collection](/en/about-the-collection)

## Exhibition *Van Gogh, All Our Paintings*

For the first time since 1984, you can see all the paintings by Vincent van Gogh from the Kröller-Müller collection. An absolute must for Van Gogh enthusiasts!

[More about the exhibition](/en/what-s-on/exhibitions/van-gogh-all-our-paintings)

![Painting by Vincent van Gogh, a historical scene showing a man helping another man off a horse.](https://museumplatform.b-cdn.net/images/ex28vlu5/production/0cd5ab00921782e54270190ca3b940f34b0763a3-4000x4881.jpg?w=3840&auto=format "Vincent van Gogh, _The Good Samaritan (after Delacroix)_, early May 1890")
